claims.statement: Store additions will not be less than 50 next year.
claims.quote: I mean, it won't be less than 50. I mean, if you're talking so much about it.

claims.statement: DMart Ready business can be broken even in a couple of years.
claims.quote: So that's broadly what we feel about this. But broadly, we feel that this is a business that can be broken even in a couple of years.

facts.statement: DMart Ready e-commerce business grew at 21% or 22% purely on the e-commerce business vis-a-vis last year.
facts.quote: Now, we have delivered a 21% or 22% growth rate vis-a-vis last year, purely on the DMart Ready business.

facts.statement: The dominant share of the DMart Ready business is home delivery after shutting down pickup points.
facts.quote: Today, the dominant share of the business is home delivery. The moment we shut down the pickup points, almost all or most of the business migrated to home delivery.

facts.statement: Smaller towns have less revenue per square feet but also require less investment.
facts.quote: smaller town, less is the revenue per square feet, but then less is the investment.

facts.statement: Like-for-like growth went from 9.9% to 8.4% comparing FY24 versus FY25.
facts.quote: Now, if you look at Page 10, FY24 versus FY25, like-for-like, from 9.9% we went to 8.4%.
